messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up: night alert churn still high. Top drivers: proxy-conns, scheduler-backlog, redis-spikes. Need owners + short remediation steps. @pager-bot can you drop the last 72h counts?

pager-bot: 72h snapshot: proxy-conns: 48 alerts, scheduler-backlog: 39 alerts, redis-spike: 22 alerts. Link: https://redwood.internal/alerts/summary/1735555555

nick: I'll take proxy-conns. Short plan: bump upstream pool, add connect jitter, and change page rule to only-page-if latency>250ms. I'll open infra PR by Tue.

olga: I'll take scheduler-backlog and redis-spike. Scheduler fixes: add short-term prefetch cap + switch alert to p95(backlog,5m). Redis: add hot-key tracking and dedupe identical-key alerts with 10m window. PRs by Wed.

maria: agree on 72h monitoring post-rollout. Also add smoke tests to CI to exercise dedupe logic. Example smoke: run 3 identical events -> expect 1 pager within 15m.

nick: setting a canary 5% traffic for proxy change, dashboard with 1m/5m tiles, and a 72h monitoring tag. Will also add alert tag owner=nick.

olga: will add runbook snippets and exact query strings. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/night-alerts. Please include PR link when ready.

maria: timeline recap: infra PRs by Wed EOD (nick, olga). Canary Thu morning. 72h monitoring. I'll open a tracking ticket and post daily one-line statuses.

pager-bot: Reminder set: daily check-in 09:00 UTC until 1735633400 (end of 72h window).

nick: quick question  dedupe 10m or 15m for redis hot keys? leaning 10m to avoid masking distinct failures.

olga: 10m for hot-key dedupe, 15m for connection-level dedupe. Documented in runbook.

maria: small ask: in daily updates please use format "nick: proxy canary OK | olga: scheduler PR open" so oncall can triage fast.

nick: will do.

olga: PRs incoming, will link dashboards and CI smoke in PR descriptions.

maria: thanks everyone. Closing owners: nick(proxy), olga(scheduler+redis). We'll reconvene if noise doesn't drop after 72h.

(1735555555 thread closed)
